description: REGRESSION for DATA-SECURITY-2.md finding #5: UPDATE is a write-usage table reference (sqlparse's own three-way read/write/admin split has no separate 'update' bucket), but @sql now maps that to the specific ego.table.update permission based on the statement's own kind, not to ego.table.write -- squ{{SQLTESTID}} holds only table.write at this point (granted at sql-13), so this must now be denied. Before the fix this succeeded, because every UPDATE was authorized as if it were an INSERT.

body: UPDATE t{{SQLTESTID}} SET name = 'Alicia' WHERE id = 1
